The first paragraph starts the left column with a short account of a harbour town, its fishing fleet, and the market held on the quay every morning.

The second paragraph follows the coast road east, past a lighthouse and two coves, to a headland where the cliffs are tall enough to hide the sea from the road and the wind is strong enough to bend every tree.

The third paragraph turns inland, along a lane between stone walls, to a village with one church, one inn, and a green where the fair is held each summer.
